title: Terms of Use
excerpt: The terms that govern use of the NeoGraph Analytics site, and the licence that comes with a purchased research report.
content:
These Terms of Use govern your access to the NeoGraph Analytics website and your use of the research we publish and sell through it, including market reports, data tables, charts, analysis articles and press releases. By browsing the site or ordering a report you accept these terms. If you are accepting them for an employer or client, you confirm you are authorised to do so on its behalf.

What we publish

NeoGraph Analytics is a research publication. Our reports combine company disclosures, regulatory filings, clinical and trade registries, government and multilateral statistics, and our own modelling. Each report states the sources behind its figures, and every chart carries the source of the data it displays.

Market sizes, shares, growth rates and forecasts are estimates and projections, not statements of fact. They are produced in good faith from the best information available at the date of publication, and they will differ from outcomes. Nothing we publish is investment, legal, tax, medical or regulatory advice, and it must not be relied on as the sole basis for a transaction or a clinical decision. You remain responsible for your own diligence.

Ordering and payment

  • Each report is licensed individually. The price shown on the report page is the price for that report, in US dollars, exclusive of any taxes or duties that apply where you are.
  • Orders are completed by our team. When you submit an inquiry from a report or checkout page we contact you at the email address you gave to confirm scope, licence type and payment.
  • Delivery is digital, to the email address on the order, once payment has cleared.
  • Cancellation before delivery and refunds after it are covered by our Cancellation Policy and Refund Policy, which form part of these terms.

Your licence to use a report

A purchased report is licensed, not sold. Unless your order says otherwise, a purchase grants one named user at the purchasing organisation a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the report for that organisation's internal business purposes. Under that licence you may:

  • read, store and print the report for internal use;
  • circulate it to colleagues who need it for the same internal purpose, where your order includes a team or enterprise licence;
  • quote limited extracts - a figure, a sentence, a single chart - in internal documents, and in external material where you attribute the extract to NeoGraph Analytics and name the report.

You may not resell, sub-license, syndicate, publish or otherwise make a report or a substantial part of one available outside your organisation; remove or alter attribution, source notes or copyright notices; or use a report to build or train a competing data product. Where a client, regulator or auditor requires access to material we licensed to you, contact us and we will arrange terms.

Free and public material

Pages on this site that are free to read - report summaries, analysis articles, press releases and the charts within them - may be cited and linked with attribution to NeoGraph Analytics and a link to the page. Reproducing a whole page, or systematically copying our material into another publication or dataset, requires written permission.

Automated access

You may not scrape, crawl or bulk-extract this site in a way that degrades it for other readers, and you may not circumvent access controls on paid material. Automated and machine-learning access to our public pages is governed by /llms.txt and robots.txt; following them does not grant any licence to paid reports.

Intellectual property

All reports, text, charts, data compilations, page design and the NeoGraph Analytics name and marks are owned by NeoGraph Analytics or its licensors and are protected by copyright and related rights. Third-party names, marks and logos that appear in our research are the property of their owners and are used for identification and commentary only. Nothing in these terms transfers ownership of anything to you.

Availability and liability

We work to keep the site available and our research accurate, but we do not warrant that the site will be uninterrupted or error-free, or that any figure or forecast will prove correct. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, lost profit, lost revenue or lost opportunity arising from use of the site or of a report, and our total liability for any claim relating to a report is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing here excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including for fraud.

Personal data

How we collect and handle the details you give us - on a contact, sample or purchase form - is set out in our Privacy Policy.

Who you are contracting with

NeoGraph Analytics operates from Austin, Texas and from Pune, India, where NeoGraph Analytics Pvt. Ltd. is registered. The contracting entity for a given order, and the law that governs it, are stated on that order before you pay. If a dispute arises, raise it with support@neographanalytics.com first - most questions about scope, licence or delivery are settled there.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms as our offering changes; the revision date at the top of this page tells you when they last changed, and material changes take effect for orders placed after that date. Questions about licensing, attribution or an existing order should go to support@neographanalytics.com.
